snippet.title: Aliens  Colonial Marines / TemplarGFX v6.2 Overhaul Mod / Part 1
snippet.description: So I'm getting ready for  Aliens Fireteam Elite by revisiting an old favorite. I gotta say... this game got a really bad rap. It certainly deserved some of it based on the initial trailers that were shown... but going back now and replaying this game, fully modded out, is actually quite fun! The game is oozing with atmosphere (quite literally) and the sound effects are straight out of the movie! Enjoy!
